verdict.rationale: Probes show no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at zulip.com/llms.txt), no markdown docs endpoint (404 at /api/.md), and no OpenAPI spec at any published candidate path. The OpenAPI YAML in the GitHub repo is a machine-readable API spec for developers, not an agent-oriented docs feature, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
